017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker.console;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
024
025/**
026 * The built-in {@code thresholds} decorator: a horizontal mark line at a y value, on a carrier series
027 * {@code juneau-thresholds-<n>}.
028 *
029 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
030 * <p class='bjava'>
031 *    Thresholds.<jsm>at</jsm>(500).label(<js>"SLO"</js>).tone(<js>"danger"</js>);
032 * </p>
033 *
034 * @since 10.0.0
035 */
036public final class Thresholds implements Decorator {
037
038   private static final Set<String> TONES = Set.of("danger", "ok", "warning");
039
040   private final Map<String,Object> value = new LinkedHashMap<>();
041
042   private Thresholds() {}
043
044   /** @param y The y value. @return A new decorator. */
045   public static Thresholds at(Number y) {
046      if (y == null)
047         throw iaex("Thresholds y must not be null.");
048      var x = new Thresholds();
049      x.value.put("y", y);
050      return x;
051   }
052
053   /** @param v The line label. @return This object. */
054   public Thresholds label(String v) { value.put("label", v); return this; }
055
056   /** @param v {@code danger}, {@code ok} or {@code warning}. @return This object. */
057   public Thresholds tone(String v) {
058      if (! TONES.contains(v))
059         throw iaex("Thresholds tone '%s' must be 'danger', 'ok' or 'warning'.", v);
060      value.put("tone", v);
061      return this;
062   }
063
064   @Override
065   public JsonMap toJson() { return JsonMap.of("use", "thresholds", "values", List.of(new LinkedHashMap<>(value))); }
066}
